title: Drive from the subsystem
summary: Fill in the ARCADE case so the drivetrain subsystem drives with the sticks.

steps.title: Open DrivetrainSubsystem.java
steps.say: The drive code moves out of Robot.java and into the subsystem. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `DrivetrainSubsystem` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+F**, type `drive with arcade drive` and press Enter to jump to it.

target.text: drive with arcade drive using the driver's sticks

waitFor.hint: find drive with arcade drive with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: The ARCADE case
steps.say: Write the line the comment describes: `drive.arcadeDrive(OI.getForward(), OI.getTurn());`. Robot.java already asks for the ARCADE state in teleop, so this is the code that runs.

target.text: drive with arcade drive using the driver's sticks

marks.label: runs while the state is ARCADE
